title: ‘Trump of the Tropics’: How Brazil’s President Came to Power

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责报道《纽约时报》每日简讯

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: DealBook的商业与政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场，采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Today, I'm very thrilled to welcome President Bolsonaro of Brazil for his first visit to the
sentences.zh: 今天，我非常高兴地欢迎巴西总统博索纳罗首次访问

sentences.en: White House.
sentences.zh: 白宫。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, President Trump held a joint news conference with the newly elected president of Brazil, Jair Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普总统与巴西新当选总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗举行了联合新闻发布会。

sentences.en: President Bolsonaro, I want to congratulate you again on your tremendous election victory.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗总统，我要再次祝贺你在选举中取得巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: Last October, it was an incredible feat and really a truly incredible
sentences.zh: 去年10月，这是一项令人难以置信的壮举，确实是一个真正不可思议的

sentences.en: challenge.
sentences.zh: 挑战。

sentences.en: And the end result was something the whole world was talking about.
sentences.zh: 最终结果是全世界都在谈论的话题。

sentences.en: The campaign he ran and his brash style have earned Bolsonaro the nickname the Trump of the
sentences.zh: 他开展的竞选活动和傲慢的风格为博索纳罗赢得了“热带特朗普”的绰号，特朗普对这个比较表示欣然接受，并称深感荣幸。

sentences.en: Tropics, a comparison that Trump has embraced and said he is honored by.
sentences.zh: 热带特朗普的绰号，特朗普对这个比较表示接受，并称以此为荣。

sentences.en: I also know that we're going to have a fantastic working relationship.
sentences.zh: 我也知道我们将建立极佳的工作关系。

sentences.en: We have many views that are similar.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多相似的观点。

sentences.en: My colleague,
sentences.zh: 我的同事，

sentences.en: Ernesto Londano, on the story of Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 埃尔内斯托·隆达诺，带来关于博索纳罗的报道。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, March 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月20日，星期三。

sentences.en: So who is Bolsonaro and how did he enter Brazilian politics?
sentences.zh: 那么博索纳罗是谁？他是如何进入巴西政坛的？

sentences.en: Bolsonaro is a former army captain.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗曾是一名陆军上尉。

sentences.en: He was a paratrooper who had a pretty short and fairly turbulent stint in the military.
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名伞兵，在军队里的经历相当短暂且颇为动荡。

sentences.en: He actually got kicked out.
sentences.zh: 他实际上是被开除的。

sentences.en: But after leaving the military in not the best of terms, he was very successful at sliding into a political career, initially as a city council member in his native Rio de Janeiro.
sentences.zh: 但在并不算愉快的退伍之后，他非常成功地踏入了政坛，最初在他家乡里约热内卢担任市议员。

sentences.en: And then very soon, he found his way to the capital of Brasilia as a congressman.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他作为国会议员来到了首都巴西利亚。

sentences.en: The dictatorship was at its most harsh in the late sixties and early seventies.
sentences.zh: 在六十年代末和七十年代初，独裁统治达到了最严厉的时期。

sentences.en: And the country was emerging from a pretty traumatic period.
sentences.zh: 这个国家正从一段相当痛苦的时期中走出来。

sentences.en: Student demonstrations in 1968, calling for the restoration of democratic rights, prompted a strong response from the military.
sentences.zh: 1968年呼吁恢复民主权利的学生示威活动，引发了军方的强烈回应。

sentences.en: It was definitely an era of repression, of terror for many groups that were at odds with
sentences.zh: 对许多与军政府意见相左的群体来说，这绝对是一个压迫、恐怖的时代，

sentences.en: the military government, and a pretty widespread censorship and curtailment of civil rights.
sentences.zh: 并且伴随着广泛的审查制度和对公民权利的削减。

sentences.en: Many of those arrested were to face torture.
sentences.zh: 许多被捕的人将面临酷刑。

sentences.en: But in 88, lawmakers passed a very progressive constitution.
sentences.zh: 但在88年，立法者通过了一部非常进步的宪法。

sentences.en: It's 29 years since Brazil last held free presidential elections.
sentences.zh: 距离巴西上次举行自由总统选举已经过去29年了。

sentences.en: If there's one point where it became starkly clear that Brazil had reached cruising altitude as a democracy,
sentences.zh: 如果说有一个时刻能清晰地表明巴西作为民主国家已经达到了巡航高度，

sentences.en: it would have been the election of Luis Ignacio da Silva, commonly known as Lula, in 2002.
sentences.zh: 那一定是在2002年路易斯·伊纳西奥·达·席尔瓦（通常被称为卢拉）的当选。
zh_words: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·达·席尔瓦

sentences.en: Lula was a former shoeshiner, son of a single mother, raised poor, rose to prominence as a union leader,
sentences.zh: 卢拉曾是一名擦鞋童，由单亲母亲抚养长大，家境贫寒，作为工会领袖崭露头角，

sentences.en: started building a political movement during the era of military rule, and was briefly jailed as a political prisoner.
sentences.zh: 在军事统治时期开始建立政治运动，并曾短时间作为政治犯入狱。

sentences.en: And when he is sworn in, in 2003, the region really sort of took a look at Brazil and said, wow, this country has really turned a corner.
sentences.zh: 当他在2003年宣誓就职时，整个地区确实审视了一下巴西，并说，哇，这个国家真的转危为安了。

sentences.en: If a man like Lula can get elected in Brazil, Brazil has really matured as a democracy.
sentences.zh: 如果像卢拉这样的人能够在巴西当选，巴西作为民主国家确实已经成熟了。

sentences.en: And what role does Bolsonaro play in the midst of this pre-dramatic shift in Brazil?
sentences.zh: 在巴西这一戏剧性转变的过程中，博索纳罗扮演了什么角色？

sentences.en: Bolsonaro was seen as kind of a loud and obnoxious lawmaker who would just get into these shouting matches in Congress, would deliver these fiery speeches.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗被视为一个吵闹且令人讨厌的议员，他只会在国会里陷入这种争吵，发表激昂的演讲。

sentences.en: He became infamous for saying things that were very offensive about women.
sentences.zh: 他因发表对女性非常无礼的言论而变得声名狼藉。

sentences.en: And about blacks.
sentences.zh: 还有关于黑人的。

sentences.en: About gays.
sentences.zh: 关于同性恋者的。

sentences.en: He made the news, for instance, when he got into a shouting match with a female lawmaker.
sentences.zh: 例如，当他与一名女议员发生争吵时，登上了新闻头条。

sentences.en: And told her that she was too ugly to rape.
sentences.zh: 并告诉她，她长得太丑，不配被强奸。

sentences.en: And the most startling thing, and it was a theme he went back and back to, was his praise for the era of military rule.
sentences.zh: 最令人震惊的事情，也是他一再提及的主题，是他对军事统治时代的赞美。

sentences.en: That Brazil needed strongmen at the helm, and that this experiment with democracy was not taking the country in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 认为巴西需要铁腕人物掌舵，这种民主试验并没有把国家带向正确的方向。

sentences.en: So just as kind of modern democratic Brazil is coming into form, it sounds like Bolsonaro
sentences.zh: 因此，正当现代民主巴西成型之际，听起来博索纳罗

sentences.en: is entering politics, but is pushing in the other direction for less democracy, more authoritarianism.
sentences.zh: 正在进入政坛，却在朝着另一个方向推动：减少民主，增加威权主义。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: He essentially made the case only the military can run this large, unwieldy country effectively.
sentences.zh: 他基本上认为，只有军队才能有效管理这个庞大而臃肿的国家。

sentences.en: And we're wasting our time thinking that this experiment with democracy is going to take us anywhere productive.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这种民主试验能把我们带到任何有生产力的地方，是在浪费时间。

sentences.en: And what was the response to moments like that?
sentences.zh: 面对这样的时刻，各方有何反应？

sentences.en: Largely speaking, people started saying, well, that's just Bolsonaro being Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，人们开始说，这不过是博索纳罗老调重弹罢了。

sentences.en: He made headlines.
sentences.zh: 他上了头条。

sentences.en: He was admonished.
sentences.zh: 他受到了训诫。

sentences.en: He was criticized.
sentences.zh: 他受到了批评。

sentences.en: But he was not somebody who was really taken seriously.
sentences.zh: 但他并不是一个真正被严肃对待的人。

sentences.en: He was not somebody who was center stage when big deals were being negotiated.
sentences.zh: 在达成重大交易时，他并非核心人物。

sentences.en: For most of his career, he was a little bit of a sideshow.
sentences.zh: 在他的大半个政治生涯中，他都有点像是个边缘人物。

sentences.en: And at the same time...
sentences.zh: 与此同时……

sentences.en: In Brazil, Petrobras recently made what could be the world's biggest oil discovery since the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，巴西国家石油公司最近作出了可能是自20世纪70年代以来全球最大的石油发现。

sentences.en: Lula had a remarkably successful first term as president, and Brazilians started seeing some pretty sweeping changes.
sentences.zh: 卢拉的第一任总统任期取得了显著的成功，巴西人开始看到一些相当剧烈的变化。

sentences.en: Brazil, like much of the region, was enjoying a commodities boom.
sentences.zh: 巴西和该地区的大部分国家一样，正享受着大宗商品热潮。

sentences.en: The discovery could mean that Brazil will become one of the world's leading oil exporters.
sentences.zh: 这一发现可能意味着巴西将成为世界领先的石油出口国之一。

sentences.en: There were some pretty groundbreaking policies that paved the way for people from poor families, people from rural communities, for the first time to go to university.
sentences.zh: 有一些具有开创性的政策，为来自贫困家庭、农村社区的人们首次进入大学铺平了道路。

sentences.en: In just seven years, almost 30 million Brazilians have joined the ranks of the middle class.
sentences.zh: 在短短七年里，近3000万巴西人跨入了中产阶级的行列。

sentences.en: Some helped by government handouts, others through improved education, which leads to higher wages.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人得到了政府的救济，另一些人则通过改善教育获得了更高的薪水。

sentences.en: There was a sense that inequality was diminishing in a country where it's long been really hard to move up the ladder.
sentences.zh: 人们感觉到，在一个长期以来很难向上流动的国家，不平等现象正在减少。

sentences.en: And Brazil started aspiring to great things.
sentences.zh: 巴西开始追求伟大的目标。

sentences.en: Brazil started making alliances with other large economies like Russia and China and South Africa, and kind of projecting itself on the world stage as a rising power.
sentences.zh: 巴西开始与俄罗斯、中国和南非等其他主要经济体结盟，作为崛起中的大国在世界舞台上展现自己。

sentences.en: I think this all became crystal clear, just kind of a sense of optimism in the sense that Brazil seemed unstoppable when...
sentences.zh: 我认为这一切变得极其清晰，那种乐观的情绪，即巴西似乎势不可挡，当……

sentences.en: I have the honor to announce that the Games of the 31st Olympiad are awarded to the city of Rio de Janeiro.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸地宣布，第三十一届奥运会的主办城市是里约热内卢。

sentences.en: In 2009, Brazil beat the odds and won the rights to host the 2016 Olympic Games.
sentences.zh: 2009年，巴西打破重重阻碍，赢得了2016年奥运会的主办权。

sentences.en: And, you know, looking back now at how optimistic, you know, the scenes of people partying on the beach in Copacabana, just celebrating this major triumph for Brazil,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，现在回想起来，那种人们在科帕卡巴纳海滩上狂欢、庆祝巴西这一重大胜利的乐观场景，

sentences.en: it seems impossible to think now that the seeds of what would happen next had already been planted.
sentences.zh: 让人很难想象接下来发生的事情的种子其实已经种下了。

sentences.en: And the reality was that underneath this triumphant country that seemed to be rising into a bright new era,
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，在这个似乎正在崛起进入光辉新时代、看似凯旋的国家表面之下，

sentences.en: underneath all that, there was a lot of rot, and it would take a few years for people here to discover just how much.
sentences.zh: 在这一切的底层，存在着许多腐败，这里的人们需要几年时间才能发现究竟有多少腐败。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能查阅所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Ernesto, how did this rot that you described, this ugliness beneath the surface, eventually get exposed?
sentences.zh: 那么，埃尔内斯托，你所描述的这种腐败、表象之下的丑陋，最终是如何被曝光的呢？

sentences.en: Well, things in Brazil started taking a definite turn for the worse in 2014.
sentences.zh: 嗯，2014年巴西的事情开始出现明显的恶化。

sentences.en: Two major things happened.
sentences.zh: 发生了两件大事。

sentences.en: On the one hand, the economy, which had been on a slide, entered into recession.
sentences.zh: 一方面，原本一直在下滑的经济陷入了衰退。

sentences.en: On the other hand, a team of investigators stumbled into a major scandal while they were looking at some funny financial transactions initially at a gas station.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，一组调查人员在最初调查加油站的一些可疑金融交易时，偶然发现了一个重大丑闻。

sentences.en: In the past week, Brazilians have had wall-to-wall coverage of a political scandal threatening to bring down the country's government.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一周里，巴西人一直在密切关注一场有可能导致国家政府倒台的政治丑闻的全面报道。

sentences.en: It first came to light when Brazilian police uncovered a money laundering operation at a car wash.
sentences.zh: 它最初是在巴西警方在一个洗车场揭发洗钱活动时曝光的。

sentences.en: It's known as Operation Car Wash.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的“洗车行动”。

sentences.en: That quickly reached very, very deeply into very powerful politicians and the top companies in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 这很快就深深地触及了极具权势的政客和巴西的顶级公司。

sentences.en: The investigation centers on a billion-dollar corruption scandal at Brazil's mammoth oil corporation, Petrobras.
sentences.zh: 该调查的核心是巴西巨型石油公司——巴西国家石油公司（Petrobras）的一起价值数十亿美元的腐败丑闻。

sentences.en: Petrobras is one of Brazil's biggest companies.
sentences.zh: 巴西国家石油公司是巴西最大的公司之一。

sentences.en: It's alleged senior officials took almost $700 million in bribes when awarding construction contracts.
sentences.zh: 据称，高级官员在授予建筑合同时收受了近7亿美元的贿赂。

sentences.en: Many that may have taken bribes are linked to the government.
sentences.zh: 许多可能收受贿赂的人都与政府有关联。

sentences.en: We're talking about massive companies that had entire departments with the task of paying bribes to politicians.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是一些拥有专门负责向政客行贿部门的大型企业。

sentences.en: The speaker of Brazil's lower house of Congress has been charged over alleged involvement in a corruption scandal.
sentences.zh: 巴西众议院议长因涉嫌卷入腐败丑闻而被起诉。

sentences.en: News breaking in the last hour that the former president of Brazil is being detained by police after a raid on his home and office in Michele Cruz.
sentences.zh: 过去一小时内打破的新闻：巴西前总统在对他在米歇尔·克鲁斯的家和办公室进行搜查后，正被警方拘留。

sentences.en: It soon became apparent to Brazilians that corruption had been institutionalized.
sentences.zh: 巴西人很快意识到，腐败已经制度化了。

sentences.en: Five former Brazilian presidents, nearly one out of three cabinet ministers, and almost one out of three senators have been indicted or investigated.
sentences.zh: 五位巴西前总统、近三分之一的内阁部长以及近三分之一的参议员遭到起诉或调查。

sentences.en: And what was the reaction in the general Brazilian public once all this corruption comes to light?
sentences.zh: 一旦所有这些腐败浮出水面，巴西广大公众的反应是什么？

sentences.en: There was outrage.
sentences.zh: 引发了愤怒。

sentences.en: As the scandal started engulfing some of the pillars of the economy here, some of the biggest companies in the country, unemployment goes up, people's purchasing power goes down,
sentences.zh: 随着丑闻开始吞噬这里的经济支柱、国家的一些大公司，失业率上升，人们的购买力下降，

sentences.en: and state governments start going bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 并且各州政府开始破产。

sentences.en: In some places, this means the police aren't getting paid and people start seeing a surge of violence.
sentences.zh: 在某些地方，这意味着警察拿不到工资，人们开始看到暴力激增。

sentences.en: With more than 50,000 violent deaths every year, Brazil has one of the world's highest homicide rates.
sentences.zh: 巴西每年有超过5万起暴力死亡事件，是世界上凶杀率最高的国家之一。

sentences.en: They go from a period of feeling optimistic and almost euphoric about the future to a period of despair and anguish.
sentences.zh: 他们从对未来感到乐观甚至欣喜若狂的时期，转变为绝望和痛苦的时期。

sentences.en: And where is Bolsonaro in all of this?
sentences.zh: 在这这一切中，博索纳罗在哪里？

sentences.en: Bolsonaro is one of the rarer veteran lawmakers who has not really been splattered by these corruption investigations.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗是为数不多的没有被这些腐败调查真正沾染的资深议员之一。

sentences.en: And at this time, he starts getting a fair amount of traction.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，他开始获得相当多的关注。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, this guy who had kind of been, you know, a fringe character comes more into sync with how Brazilians were feeling about their lot in life.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这个曾经可以说是边缘人物的家伙，变得更加符合巴西人对自己命运的看法。

sentences.en: Around 2016, he starts telling people that he wants to take a shot at the presidency.
sentences.zh: 大约在2016年，他开始告诉人们他想竞选总统。

sentences.en: And the way he spread his message was unique in the history of Brazilian presidential races.
sentences.zh: 他传播信息的方式在巴西总统竞选史上是独一无二的。

sentences.en: He was campaigning largely by sitting in front of a phone, which was often shaky.
sentences.zh: 他主要通过坐在经常晃动的手机前进行竞选。

sentences.en: And just broadcasting videos live on Facebook, on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 并在Facebook和Instagram上进行直播视频。

sentences.en: Where he was speaking to people as though they were long-lost friends.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他与人们交谈，就像对待失散多年的朋友一样。

sentences.en: It was completely unscripted, oftentimes a stream of consciousness.
sentences.zh: 这完全是即兴的，通常是一种意识流。

sentences.en: He would jump from one subject to another.
sentences.zh: 他会从一个主题跳到另一个主题。

sentences.en: And I think people saw that as pretty refreshing.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们觉得这相当耳目一新。

sentences.en: People were so disgusted with politics as usual in the political establishment that they saw in this guy who had been in the fringes for so long
sentences.zh: 人们对政治建制派习以为常的政治感到无比厌恶，以至于他们在长期处于边缘的这个人身上看到

sentences.en: somebody who could radically reinvent the system.
sentences.zh: 一个能够彻底重塑体制的人。

sentences.en: And does he have the stature at this moment to do that?
sentences.zh: 此刻他有这样的威望来做到这一点吗？

sentences.en: When the very first rumblings of a Bolsonaro presidential bid start coming up, people laughed it off.
sentences.zh: 当博索纳罗竞选总统的最初传闻开始出现时，人们一笑了之。

sentences.en: The conventional wisdom was he's too extreme.
sentences.zh: 传统观点认为他太极端了。

sentences.en: He's too outside of the norm.
sentences.zh: 他太离经叛道了。

sentences.en: But despite the skepticism, by the end of 2017, it became pretty clear that Bolsonaro's message had strong appeal across the country.
sentences.zh: 但尽管存在怀疑，到2017年底，人们已经很清楚，博索纳罗的信息在全国各地都有很强的吸引力。

sentences.en: And what exactly is he promising on the campaign trail that the Brazilian people are finding so compelling?
sentences.zh: 他在竞选活动中究竟承诺了什么，让巴西人民觉得如此引人注目？

sentences.en: On corruption, he was very clear in stating that he was going to have no patience for business as usual.
sentences.zh: 在腐败问题上，他非常明确地表示，他对墨守成规、习以为常的做法绝无耐心。

sentences.en: And that under his tenure,
sentences.zh: 并且在他的任期内，

sentences.en: people who were corrupt had tons to fear.
sentences.zh: 腐败分子将有大把的事情要担心。

sentences.en: But I think the main promise he made to his supporters was that he was going to take extraordinary measures to restore security.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他对支持者作出的主要承诺是，他将采取非凡的措施来恢复安全。

sentences.en: And we're talking about pretty draconian things.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是相当严厉的措施。

sentences.en: Bolsonaro, for example, once said, a good criminal is a dead criminal.
sentences.zh: 例如，博索纳罗曾说过，好罪犯就是死罪犯。

sentences.en: He made it clear he was essentially going to give the police free reign to shoot suspected criminals on the spot.
sentences.zh: 他明确表示，他基本上会给予警察全权，当场射杀涉嫌犯罪的人。

sentences.en: The third thing he did, which was unusual, was surround himself with military leaders and make them kind of a core base of support.
sentences.zh: 他做的第三件不同寻常的事是，围绕在自己身边的是军事领导人，并让他们成为支持的核心基础。

sentences.en: The military had been largely out of sight in politics in Brazil for the past three decades.
sentences.zh: 在过去的三十年里，军方在巴西的政治生活中基本上隐退了。

sentences.en: So this was a pretty bold move, but actually one that captured people's imagination as they longed for a system that was more orderly and more secure.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当大胆的举动，但实际上它激发了人们的想象力，因为他们渴望一个更有序、更安全的体制。

sentences.en: So this cranky, often outrageous character is starting to connect with people.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个性格古怪、言论往往惊世骇俗的人物开始与人们产生共鸣。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: However, I think it's important to note that there were a couple of pretty crucial turning points that turbocharged his presidential bid.
sentences.zh: 不过，我认为值得注意的是，有几个非常关键的转折点极大地助推了他的总统竞选。

sentences.en: Brazil's former president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, is to stand trial for allegedly accepting over $1 million in bribes.
sentences.zh: 巴西前总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦将因涉嫌收受逾100万美元贿赂而受审。
zh_words: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席

sentences.en: Early last year, former president Lula, who had been the frontrunner, according to opinion polls, and who was trying to make a bid for a third term
sentences.zh: 去年年初，根据民意调查本是领跑者、并试图竞选总统宝座第三任期的前总统卢拉

sentences.en: in the presidential palace, got jailed.
sentences.zh: 锒铛入狱。

sentences.en: And after he gets jailed on corruption and money laundering charges, he essentially becomes disqualified.
sentences.zh: 在她因腐败和洗钱罪名入狱后，他基本上失去了参选资格。

sentences.en: And his party is in disarray.
sentences.zh: 他的政党也陷入了混乱。

sentences.en: And then you fast forward a few months, and in September of last year, there's a very dramatic moment when, on the campaign trail,
sentences.zh: 然后快进几个月，在去年的九月，出现了一个非常戏剧性的时刻：在竞选活动中，

sentences.en: Bolsonaro is marching through the streets of a small town, surrounded by supporters, and a man lunges toward him with a big kitchen knife and stabs him in the stomach.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗在支持者的簇拥下走过一个小镇的街道，一名男子突然挥舞着一把大厨房菜刀冲向他，并刺中了其腹部。

sentences.en: Jair Bolsonaro has been left in a serious but stable condition in hospital, this after being stabbed while drumming up support ahead of next month's vote.
sentences.zh: 雅伊尔·博索纳罗目前在医院接受治疗，情况严重但稳定，此前他在为下个月的投票造势时遭到刺伤。

sentences.en: Hospital officials say it could take two months for him to recover.
sentences.zh: 医院官员表示，他可能需要两个月才能康复。

sentences.en: He was essentially knocked off the campaign trail for the remainder of the race.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的竞选行程中，他基本上被迫退出了。

sentences.en: He was in a hospital bed, and then he was in his apartment, and communicating virtually only through social media.
sentences.zh: 他先是躺在病床上，然后回到公寓，实际上只能通过社交媒体进行交流。

sentences.en: People, I think, saw in this moment the kind of violence that he was railing against in a really crystallized form.
sentences.zh: 我认为，人们在这个时刻以一种非常具象的形式看到了他一直以来所抨击的暴力行为。

sentences.en: This incident that could have easily ended his life ended up propelling his bib.
sentences.zh: 这起本可能轻易夺走他生命的事件，最终却推动了他的竞选。

sentences.en: The breaking news is the far-right candidate,
sentences.zh: 突发新闻，极右翼候选人

sentences.en: Jair Bolsonaro, has won Brazil's presidential race.
sentences.zh: 雅伊尔·博索纳罗赢得了巴西总统大选。

sentences.en: And after this happens in October, he has a decisive victory.
sentences.zh: 在十月份发生这件事之后，他取得了决定性的胜利。

sentences.en: And what is the reaction across Brazil to this victory?
sentences.zh: 整个巴西对这场胜利有何反应？

sentences.en: Brazil emerges from the election pretty polarized.
sentences.zh: 巴西走出选举时呈现出相当两极分化的状态。

sentences.en: Somebody who had been a very, very long shot for the presidency was able to not just win, but win decisively.
sentences.zh: 一个原本毫无胜算的人不仅赢得了大选，而且赢得很彻底。

sentences.en: However, you also have many communities in the country that feel extraordinarily unsafe in this new Brazil and that worry that the country under Bolsonaro's watch
sentences.zh: 然而，国内也有许多群体在这个全新的巴西感到极其缺乏安全感，他们担心在博索纳罗的统治下，

sentences.en: could well transition into a new era of authoritarian rule.
sentences.zh: 这个国家很可能会过渡到一个威权统治的新时代。

sentences.en: I wonder what Bolsonaro's election means for Brazil, which, as you told us earlier, is just 30 years from having been a military dictatorship and turned to democracy
sentences.zh: 我想知道博索纳罗的当选对巴西意味着什么。正如你刚才所说，巴西摆脱军事独裁统治、转向民主仅仅过去了30年，

sentences.en: and seems to have had a pretty rocky journey.
sentences.zh: 而且这一路走来似乎相当坎坷。

sentences.en: I think it illustrates that many people, not just in Brazil, but across Latin America, had become very cynical about democracy, at least the version of democracy they were seeing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这说明了许多人，不仅在巴西，而且在整个拉丁美洲，对民主——至少是他们所看到的这种版本的民主——已经变得非常愤世嫉俗。

sentences.en: Many Brazilians felt that they were being governed by thieves who just kept getting elected by playing the old political playbook.
sentences.zh: 许多巴西人觉得，统治他们的只是一群小偷，而这些人通过玩弄旧的政治把戏不断当选。

sentences.en: And I think in the specific case of Bolsonaro, who comes with a history of having championed authoritarian rule, of wanting to govern very closely with senior military leaders,
sentences.zh: 我认为，就博索纳罗而言，他有着拥护威权统治、希望与高级军事领袖紧密合作的历史，

sentences.en: the promise of order, even if it came at the price of a rollback of civil liberties and of democracy, it was a price many Brazilians were perfectly willing to pay.
sentences.zh: 秩序的承诺——即使代价是倒退公民自由和民主——也是许多巴西人非常愿意付出的代价。

sentences.en: So to change this system that seems to not be working, it feels like Brazilians want to shock the system and perhaps test its limits,
sentences.zh: 因此，为了改变这个似乎不再起作用的体制，巴西人似乎想要给体制带来一些震撼，也许是去试探它的底线，

sentences.en: which sounds a little bit like what's going on in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点像美国目前正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: When I talked to people on the campaign trail, you know, I was really startled by the level of anguish that they expressed and their willingness to take big risks on a leader
sentences.zh: 当我在竞选活动中与人们交谈时，你知道，他们所表达的痛苦程度以及他们愿意在一个未经考验、充满疑问的领导人身上冒巨大风险的决心，让我感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: who is untested and who comes with all these question marks.
sentences.zh: 恩内斯托，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Ernesto, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Just weeks after his swearing in, when Bolsonaro vowed to, quote, rid Brazil of corruption, he faced charges that his own administration was engaging in more of the same.
sentences.zh: 就在博索纳罗宣誓就职几周后，他曾发誓要“清除巴西的腐败”，然而他却面临着指控，称他自己的政府正在重蹈覆辙。

sentences.en: Brazilian prosecutors are investigating the mysterious movement of more than $300,000 in and out of bank accounts controlled by the driver of Bolsonaro's oldest son,
sentences.zh: 巴西检察官正在调查超过30万美元神秘资金的流向，这些资金曾通过由博索纳罗长子（一名州议员）的司机控制的银行账户进出，

sentences.en: a state lawmaker, and why some of those payments went to Bolsonaro's wife.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么其中一些款项流向了博索纳罗的妻子。

sentences.en: At the same time,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Bolsonaro has appointed three government ministers who were previously implicated in investigations of corruption.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗任命了三位此前曾牵涉腐败调查的政府部长。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The Trump administration has requested an internal investigation into how the Federal Aviation Administration certified the safety of Boeing's 737 MAX 8,
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府已要求对联邦航空管理局如何认证波音737 MAX 8的安全性进行内部调查，

sentences.en: which has crashed twice in the last five months, killing nearly 350 people.
sentences.zh: 该机型在过去五个月内已坠毁两次，造成近350人死亡。

sentences.en: The certification process has come under intense scrutiny because it relies heavily on input from Boeing's own employees who were trying to quickly bring the MAX 8 to market
sentences.zh: 认证过程受到了严格审查，因为它严重依赖于波音公司自身员工的意见，这些员工试图将MAX 8尽快推向市场，

sentences.en: and believed that it required minimal pilot training.
sentences.zh: 并认为该机型只需要最少的飞行员培训。

sentences.en: And in the latest sign that the world of philanthropy is turning against the family that created the opioid OxyContin,
sentences.zh: 作为慈善界开始疏远生产阿片类药物奥施康定的家族的最新迹象，

sentences.en: London's National Portrait Gallery has rejected a $1.3 million donation from the Sackler family.
sentences.zh: 伦敦国家肖像馆拒绝了萨克勒家族130万美元的捐赠。

sentences.en: The Sacklers have built their fortune off of OxyContin, prompting calls for the recipients of their philanthropy, including the Metropolitan Museum of Art,
sentences.zh: 萨克勒家族靠奥施康定积累了巨额财富，这引发了外界呼吁其慈善捐赠的接受者（包括大都会艺术博物馆、

sentences.en: the Guggenheim, and the Louvre, to stop accepting the family's donations.
sentences.zh: 古根海姆博物馆和卢浮宫）停止接受该家族的捐赠。

sentences.en: The decision by the London Portrait Gallery is the first time that a major museum has turned down the Sacklers' money.
sentences.zh: 伦敦肖像馆的这一决定是主要博物馆首次拒绝萨克勒家族的资金。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日简报》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《电线切割机秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而昏过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么样的要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序上或在你喜欢收听播客的任何地方搜索《电线切割机秀》。
